title: Nondegeneracy of the symplectic form
statement: Let $p$ be a prime and $n \ge 0$, and let $\omega$ be the symplectic form on $V = \bbf_p^n \times \bbf_p^n$. If a vector $u \in V$ satisfies $\omega(u,v) = 0$ for every $v \in V$, then $u = 0$.
hypotheses_covered: u lies in V = F_p^n × F_p^n
ω(u,v) = 0 for all v in V
